verses.original: אָשִׁ֤ירָה נָּא֙ לִֽידִידִ֔י שִׁירַ֥ת דּוֹדִ֖י לְכַרְמ֑וֹ כֶּ֛רֶם הָיָ֥ה לִֽידִידִ֖י בְּקֶ֥רֶן בֶּן־ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·šî·rāh nā lî·ḏî·ḏî šî·raṯ dō·w·ḏî lə·ḵar·mōw ke·rem hā·yāh lî·ḏî·ḏî bə·qe·ren ben- šā·men
verses.literal: I will sing . . . for my beloved a song of his vineyard My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile . . . hill
verses.literalPt: AGORA cantarei ao meu amado o cântico do meu querido a respeito da sua vinha. O meu amado tem uma vinha num outeiro fértil.

verses.original: וַֽיְעַזְּקֵ֣הוּ וַֽיְסַקְּלֵ֗הוּ וַיִּטָּעֵ֙הוּ֙ שֹׂרֵ֔ק וַיִּ֤בֶן מִגְדָּל֙ בְּתוֹכ֔וֹ וְגַם־ יֶ֖קֶב חָצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וַיְקַ֛ו לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·‘az·zə·qê·hū way·saq·qə·lê·hū way·yiṭ·ṭā·‘ê·hū śō·rêq way·yi·ḇen miḡ·dāl bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw wə·ḡam- ye·qeḇ ḥā·ṣêḇ bōw way·qaw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ă·nā·ḇîm way·ya·‘aś bə·’u·šîm
verses.literal: He dug it up and cleared the stones and planted the finest vines He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well He waited for the vineyard to yield good grapes but the fruit it produced was sour
verses.literalPt: E cercou-a, e limpando-a das pedras, plantou-a de excelentes vides; e edificou no meio dela uma torre, e também construiu nela um lagar; e esperava que desse uvas boas, porém deu uvas bravas.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֑ה שִׁפְטוּ־ נָ֕א בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵ֥ין כַּרְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yō·wō·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh šip̄·ṭū- nā bê·nî ū·ḇên kar·mî
verses.literal: And now O dwellers of Jerusalem and men of Judah I exhort you to judge between Me . . . and My vineyard
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ó moradores de Jerusalém, e homens de Judá, julgai, vos peço, entre mim e a minha vinha.

verses.original: מַה־ לַּעֲשׂ֥וֹת עוֹד֙ לְכַרְמִ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָשִׂ֖יתִי בּ֑וֹ מַדּ֧וּעַ קִוֵּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: mah- la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḵar·mî wə·lō ‘ā·śî·ṯî bōw mad·dū·a‘ qiw·wê·ṯî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ă·nā·ḇîm way·ya·‘aś bə·’u·šîm
verses.literal: What more could have been done for My vineyard than I have done for it Why when I expected sweet grapes did it bring forth sour fruit
verses.literalPt: Que mais se podia fazer à minha vinha, que eu lhe não tenha feito? Por que, esperando eu que desse uvas boas, veio a dar uvas bravas?

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אוֹדִֽיעָה־ נָּ֣א אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְכַרְמִ֑י הָסֵ֤ר מְשׂוּכָּתוֹ֙ וְהָיָ֣ה לְבָעֵ֔ר פָּרֹ֥ץ גְּדֵר֖וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְמִרְמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ō·w·ḏî·‘āh- nā ’eṯ·ḵem ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh lə·ḵar·mî hā·sêr mə·śū·kā·ṯōw wə·hā·yāh lə·ḇā·‘êr pā·rōṣ gə·ḏê·rōw wə·hā·yāh lə·mir·mās
verses.literal: Now I will tell you . . . - what I am about to do to My vineyard I will take away its hedge and it will be consumed I will tear down its wall and it will be trampled
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, vos farei saber o que eu hei de fazer à minha vinha: tirarei a sua sebe, para que sirva de pasto; derrubarei a sua parede, para que seja pisada;

verses.original: וַאֲשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בָתָ֗ה לֹ֤א יִזָּמֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵעָדֵ֔ר וְעָלָ֥ה שָׁמִ֖יר וָשָׁ֑יִת וְעַ֤ל הֶעָבִים֙ אֲצַוֶּ֔ה מֵהַמְטִ֥יר עָלָ֖יו מָטָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šî·ṯê·hū ḇā·ṯāh lō yiz·zā·mêr wə·lō yê·‘ā·ḏêr wə·‘ā·lāh šā·mîr wā·šā·yiṯ wə·‘al he·‘ā·ḇîm ’ă·ṣaw·weh mê·ham·ṭîr ‘ā·lāw mā·ṭār
verses.literal: I will make it a wasteland neither pruned nor cultivated and thorns and briers will grow up I will command the clouds that rain shall not fall on it
verses.literalPt: E a tornarei em deserto; não será podada nem cavada; porém crescerão nela sarças e espinheiros; e às nuvens darei ordem que não derramem chuva sobre ela.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֜רֶם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה נְטַ֖ע שַׁעֲשׁוּעָ֑יו וַיְקַ֤ו לְמִשְׁפָּט֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִשְׂפָּ֔ח לִצְדָקָ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה צְעָקָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḵe·rem Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh nə·ṭa‘ ša·‘ă·šū·‘āw way·qaw lə·miš·pāṭ wə·hin·nêh miś·pāḥ liṣ·ḏā·qāh wə·hin·nêh ṣə·‘ā·qāh
verses.literal: For the vineyard of the LORD of Hosts is the house of Israel and the men of Judah are the plant of His delight He looked for justice but saw bloodshed for righteousness but heard a cry of distress
verses.literalPt: Porque a vinha do SENHOR dos Exércitos é a casa de Israel, e os homens de Judá são a planta das suas delícias; e esperou que exercesse juízo, e eis aqui opressão; justiça, e eis aqui clamor.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֙יִת֙ בְּבַ֔יִת שָׂדֶ֥ה בְשָׂדֶ֖ה יַקְרִ֑יבוּ עַ֚ד אֶ֣פֶס מָק֔וֹם וְהֽוּשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לְבַדְּכֶ֖ם בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w mag·gî·‘ê ḇa·yiṯ bə·ḇa·yiṯ śā·ḏeh ḇə·śā·ḏeh yaq·rî·ḇū ‘aḏ ’e·p̄es mā·qō·wm wə·hū·šaḇ·tem lə·ḇad·də·ḵem bə·qe·reḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field until no place is left and you live alone in the land
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que ajuntam casa a casa, reúnem campo a campo, até que não haja mais lugar, e fiquem como únicos moradores no meio da terra!

verses.original: בְּאָזְנָ֖י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־ לֹ֞א בָּתִּ֤ים רַבִּים֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה יִֽהְי֔וּ גְּדֹלִ֥ים וְטוֹבִ֖ים מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ā·zə·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’im- lō bāt·tîm rab·bîm lə·šam·māh yih·yū gə·ḏō·lîm wə·ṭō·w·ḇîm mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: I heard the LORD of Hosts declare Surely . . . many houses will become desolate great mansions . . . left unoccupied
verses.literalPt: A meus ouvidos disse o SENHOR dos Exércitos: Em verdade que muitas casas ficarão desertas, e até as grandes e excelentes sem moradores.

verses.original: כִּ֗י עֲשֶׂ֙רֶת֙ צִמְדֵּי־ כֶ֔רֶם יַעֲשׂ֖וּ בַּ֣ת אֶחָ֑ת וְזֶ֥רַע חֹ֖מֶר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֵיפָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ă·śe·reṯ ṣim·dê- ḵe·rem ya·‘ă·śū baṯ ’e·ḥāṯ wə·ze·ra‘ ḥō·mer ya·‘ă·śeh ’ê·p̄āh
verses.literal: For ten acres of vineyard will yield but a bath of wine and a homer of seed only an ephah of grain
verses.literalPt: E dez jeiras de vinha não darão mais do que um bato; e um ômer de semente não dará mais do que um efa.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מַשְׁכִּימֵ֥י בַבֹּ֖קֶר שֵׁכָ֣ר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַנֶּ֔שֶׁף יַ֖יִן יַדְלִיקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w maš·kî·mê ḇab·bō·qer šê·ḵār yir·dō·p̄ū mə·’a·ḥă·rê ḇan·ne·šep̄ ya·yin yaḏ·lî·qêm
verses.literal: Woe to those who rise early in the morning in pursuit of strong drink who linger into the evening to be inflamed by wine
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que se levantam pela manhã, e seguem a bebedice; e continuam até à noite, até que o vinho os esquente!

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה כִנּ֜וֹר וָנֶ֗בֶל תֹּ֧ף וְחָלִ֛יל וָיַ֖יִן מִשְׁתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת פֹּ֤עַל יְהוָה֙ לֹ֣א יַבִּ֔יטוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵin·nō·wr wā·ne·ḇel tōp̄ wə·ḥā·lîl wā·ya·yin miš·tê·hem wə·’êṯ pō·‘al Yah·weh lō yab·bî·ṭū ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw lō rā·’ū
verses.literal: At their feasts are the lyre and harp tambourines and flutes and wine They disregard the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands
verses.literalPt: E harpas e alaúdes, tamboris e gaitas, e vinho há nos seus banquetes; e não olham para a obra do SENHOR, nem consideram as obras das suas mãos.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן גָּלָ֥ה עַמִּ֖י מִבְּלִי־ דָ֑עַת וּכְבוֹדוֹ֙ מְתֵ֣י רָעָ֔ב וַהֲמוֹנ֖וֹ צִחֵ֥ה צָמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên gā·lāh ‘am·mî mib·bə·lî- ḏā·‘aṯ ū·ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏōw mə·ṯê rā·‘āḇ wa·hă·mō·w·nōw ṣi·ḥêh ṣā·mā
verses.literal: Therefore My people will go into exile for their lack of understanding their dignitaries . . . are starving and their masses are parched with thirst
verses.literalPt: Portanto o meu povo será levado cativo, por falta de entendimento; e os seus nobres terão fome, e a sua multidão se secará de sede.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִרְחִ֤יבָה שְּׁאוֹל֙ נַפְשָׁ֔הּ וּפָעֲרָ֥ה פִ֖יהָ לִבְלִי־ חֹ֑ק וְיָרַ֨ד הֲדָרָ֧הּ וַהֲמוֹנָ֛הּ וּשְׁאוֹנָ֖הּ וְעָלֵ֥ז בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hir·ḥî·ḇāh šə·’ō·wl nap̄·šāh ū·p̄ā·‘ă·rāh p̄î·hā liḇ·lî- ḥōq wə·yā·raḏ hă·ḏā·rāh wa·hă·mō·w·nāh ū·šə·’ō·w·nāh wə·‘ā·lêz bāh
verses.literal: Therefore Sheol enlarges its throat and opens wide its enormous . . . jaws and down go Zion’s nobles and masses her revelers and carousers
verses.literalPt: Portanto o inferno grandemente se alargou, e se abriu a sua boca desmesuradamente; e para lá descerão o seu esplendor, e a sua multidão, e a sua pompa, e os que entre eles se alegram.

verses.original: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַיִּשְׁפַּל־ אִ֑ישׁ וְעֵינֵ֥י גְבֹהִ֖ים תִּשְׁפַּֽלְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šaḥ ’ā·ḏām way·yiš·pal- ’îš wə·‘ê·nê ḡə·ḇō·hîm tiš·pal·nāh
verses.literal: So mankind will be brought low and each man humbled the arrogant will lower their eyes
verses.literalPt: Então o plebeu se abaterá, e o nobre se humilhará; e os olhos dos altivos se humilharão.

verses.original: וַיִּגְבַּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהָאֵל֙ הַקָּד֔וֹשׁ נִקְדָּ֖שׁ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·bah Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bam·miš·pāṭ wə·hā·’êl haq·qā·ḏō·wōš niq·dāš biṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: But the LORD of Hosts will be exalted by His justice and the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness
verses.literalPt: Porém o SENHOR dos Exércitos será exaltado em juízo; e Deus, o Santo, será santificado em justiça.

verses.original: וְרָע֥וּ כְבָשִׂ֖ים כְּדָבְרָ֑ם וְחָרְב֥וֹת מֵחִ֖ים גָּרִ֥ים יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·‘ū ḵə·ḇā·śîm kə·ḏā·ḇə·rām wə·ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ mê·ḥîm gā·rîm yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Lambs will graze as in their own pastures and strangers will feed in the ruins of the wealthy
verses.literalPt: Então os cordeiros pastarão como de costume, e os estranhos comerão dos lugares devastados pelos gordos.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מֹשְׁכֵ֥י הֶֽעָוֺ֖ן בְּחַבְלֵ֣י הַשָּׁ֑וְא וְכַעֲב֥וֹת הָעֲגָלָ֖ה חַטָּאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w mō·šə·ḵê he·‘ā·wōn bə·ḥaḇ·lê haš·šāw wə·ḵa·‘ă·ḇō·wṯ hā·‘ă·ḡā·lāh ḥaṭ·ṭā·’āh
verses.literal: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of deceit and pull sin along with cart ropes
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que puxam a iniqüidade com cordas de vaidade, e o pecado com tirantes de carro!

verses.original: הָאֹמְרִ֗ים יְמַהֵ֧ר׀ יָחִ֛ישָׁה מַעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ לְמַ֣עַן נִרְאֶ֑ה וְתִקְרַ֣ב וְתָב֗וֹאָה עֲצַ֛ת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנֵדָֽעָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mə·rîm yə·ma·hêr yā·ḥî·šāh ma·‘ă·śê·hū lə·ma·‘an nir·’eh wə·ṯiq·raḇ wə·ṯā·ḇō·w·’āh ‘ă·ṣaṯ qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl wə·nê·ḏā·‘āh
verses.literal: to those who say Let Him hurry and hasten His work . . . so that we may see it . . . Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come so that we may know it
verses.literalPt: E dizem: Avie-se, e acabe a sua obra, para que a vejamos; e aproxime-se e venha o conselho do Santo de Israel, para que o conheçamos.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לָרַ֛ע ט֖וֹב וְלַטּ֣וֹב רָ֑ע שָׂמִ֨ים חֹ֤שֶׁךְ לְאוֹר֙ וְא֣וֹר לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ שָׂמִ֥ים מַ֛ר לְמָת֖וֹק וּמָת֥וֹק לְמָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w hā·’ō·mə·rîm lā·ra‘ ṭō·wḇ wə·laṭ·ṭō·wḇ rā‘ śā·mîm ḥō·šeḵ lə·’ō·wr wə·’ō·wr lə·ḥō·šeḵ śā·mîm mar lə·mā·ṯō·wq ū·mā·ṯō·wq lə·mār
verses.literal: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil who turn darkness to light and light to darkness who replace bitter with sweet and sweet with bitter
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que ao mal chamam bem, e ao bem mal; que fazem das trevas luz, e da luz trevas; e fazem do amargo doce, e do doce amargo!

verses.original: ה֖וֹי חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְנֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם נְבֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ḥă·ḵā·mîm bə·‘ê·nê·hem wə·ne·ḡeḏ pə·nê·hem nə·ḇō·nîm
verses.literal: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que são sábios a seus próprios olhos, e prudentes diante de si mesmos!

verses.original: ה֕וֹי גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים לִשְׁתּ֣וֹת יָ֑יִן וְאַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֖יִל לִמְסֹ֥ךְ שֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w gib·bō·w·rîm liš·tō·wṯ yā·yin wə·’an·šê- ḥa·yil lim·sōḵ šê·ḵār
verses.literal: Woe to those who are heroes in drinking wine and champions . . . in mixing strong drink
verses.literalPt: Ai dos que são poderosos para beber vinho, e homens de poder para misturar bebida forte;

verses.original: מַצְדִּיקֵ֥י רָשָׁ֖ע עֵ֣קֶב שֹׁ֑חַד וְצִדְקַ֥ת צַדִּיקִ֖ים יָסִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: maṣ·dî·qê rā·šā‘ ‘ê·qeḇ šō·ḥaḏ wə·ṣiḏ·qaṯ ṣad·dî·qîm yā·sî·rū mim·men·nū
verses.literal: who acquit the guilty for a bribe and deprive the innocent . . . of justice
verses.literalPt: Dos que justificam ao ímpio por suborno, e aos justos negam a justiça!

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ כֶּאֱכֹ֨ל קַ֜שׁ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֵ֗שׁ וַחֲשַׁ֤שׁ לֶֽהָבָה֙ יִרְפֶּ֔ה שָׁרְשָׁם֙ כַּמָּ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וּפִרְחָ֖ם כָּאָבָ֣ק יַעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֣י מָאֲס֗וּ אֵ֚ת תּוֹרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֵ֛ת אִמְרַ֥ת קְדֽוֹשׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִאֵֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ke·’ĕ·ḵōl qaš lə·šō·wn ’êš wa·ḥă·šaš le·hā·ḇāh yir·peh šā·rə·šām kam·māq yih·yeh ū·p̄ir·ḥām kā·’ā·ḇāq ya·‘ă·leh kî mā·’ă·sū ’êṯ tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·’êṯ ’im·raṯ qə·ḏō·wōš- yiś·rā·’êl ni·’ê·ṣū
verses.literal: Therefore as a tongue of fire consumes the straw and as dry grass shrivels in the flame so their roots will decay . . . and their blossoms will blow away like dust for they have rejected the instruction of the LORD of Hosts and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel
verses.literalPt: Por isso, como a língua de fogo consome a palha, e o restolho se desfaz pela chama, assim será a sua raiz como podridão, e a sua flor se esvaecerá como pó; porquanto rejeitaram a lei do SENHOR dos Exércitos, e desprezaram a palavra do Santo de Israel.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֡ן חָרָה֩ אַף־ יְהוָ֨ה בְּעַמּ֜וֹ וַיֵּ֣ט יָד֧וֹ עָלָ֣יו וַיַּכֵּ֗הוּ וַֽיִּרְגְּזוּ֙ הֶֽהָרִ֔ים וַתְּהִ֧י נִבְלָתָ֛ם כַּסּוּחָ֖ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב חוּצ֑וֹת בְּכָל־ זֹאת֙ לֹא־ שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ḥā·rāh ’ap̄- Yah·weh bə·‘am·mōw way·yêṭ yā·ḏōw ‘ā·lāw way·yak·kê·hū way·yir·gə·zū he·hā·rîm wat·tə·hî niḇ·lā·ṯām kas·sū·ḥāh bə·qe·reḇ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ bə·ḵāl zōṯ lō- šāḇ ’ap·pōw wə·‘ō·wḏ yā·ḏōw nə·ṭū·yāh
verses.literal: Therefore . . . the anger of the LORD burns against His people His hand is raised against them to strike them down The mountains quake and the corpses lie like refuse in the streets Despite all this His anger is not turned away His hand is still upraised
verses.literalPt: Por isso se acendeu a ira do SENHOR contra o seu povo, e estendeu a sua mão contra ele, e o feriu, de modo que as montanhas tremeram, e os seus cadáveres se fizeram como lixo no meio das ruas; com tudo isto não tornou atrás a sua ira, mas a sua mão ainda está estendida.

verses.original: וְנָֽשָׂא־ נֵ֤ס לַגּוֹיִם֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וְשָׁ֥רַק ל֖וֹ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה מְהֵרָ֖ה קַ֥ל יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śā- nês lag·gō·w·yim mê·rā·ḥō·wq wə·šā·raq lōw miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hin·nêh mə·hê·rāh qal yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: He lifts a banner for the distant nations and whistles for those at the ends of the earth Behold how speedily and swiftly they come
verses.literalPt: E ele arvorará o estandarte para as nações de longe, e lhes assobiará para que venham desde a extremidade da terra; e eis que virão apressurada e ligeiramente.

verses.original: אֵין־ עָיֵ֤ף וְאֵין־ כּוֹשֵׁל֙ בּ֔וֹ לֹ֥א יָנ֖וּם וְלֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן וְלֹ֤א נִפְתַּח֙ אֵז֣וֹר חֲלָצָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א נִתַּ֖ק שְׂר֥וֹךְ נְעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- ‘ā·yêp̄ wə·’ên- kō·wō·šêl bōw lō yā·nūm wə·lō yî·šān wə·lō nip̄·taḥ ’ê·zō·wr ḥă·lā·ṣāw wə·lō nit·taq śə·rō·wḵ nə·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: None of them grows weary or stumbles no one slumbers or sleeps No belt . . . is loose and no sandal strap is broken
verses.literalPt: Não haverá entre eles cansado, nem quem tropece; ninguém tosquenejará nem dormirá; não se lhe desatará o cinto dos seus lombos, nem se lhe quebrará a correia dos seus sapatos.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִצָּיו֙ שְׁנוּנִ֔ים וְכָל־ קַשְּׁתֹתָ֖יו דְּרֻכ֑וֹת פַּרְס֤וֹת סוּסָיו֙ כַּצַּ֣ר נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וְגַלְגִּלָּ֖יו כַּסּוּפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ḥiṣ·ṣāw šə·nū·nîm wə·ḵāl qaš·šə·ṯō·ṯāw də·ru·ḵō·wṯ par·sō·wṯ sū·sāw kaṣ·ṣar neḥ·šā·ḇū wə·ḡal·gil·lāw kas·sū·p̄āh
verses.literal: Their arrows are sharpened and all their bows are strung The hooves of their horses are like flint . . . their chariot wheels are like a whirlwind
verses.literalPt: As suas flechas serão agudas, e todos os seus arcos retesados; os cascos dos seus cavalos são reputados como pederneiras, e as rodas dos seus carros como redemoinho.

verses.original: שְׁאָגָ֥ה ל֖וֹ כַּלָּבִ֑יא וְשָׁאַג כַּכְּפִירִ֤ים וְיִנְהֹם֙ וְיֹאחֵ֣ז טֶ֔רֶף וְיַפְלִ֖יט וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ā·ḡāh lōw kal·lā·ḇî wə·šå̄·ʾaḡ kak·kə·p̄î·rîm wə·yin·hōm wə·yō·ḥêz ṭe·rep̄ wə·yap̄·lîṭ wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: Their roaring is like that of a lion they roar like young lions They growl and seize their prey they carry it away and no one can rescue it
verses.literalPt: O seu rugido será como o do leão; rugirão como filhos de leão; sim, rugirão e arrebatarão a presa, e a levarão, e não haverá quem a livre.

verses.original: וְיִנְהֹ֥ם עָלָ֛יו בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּנַהֲמַת־ יָ֑ם וְנִבַּ֤ט לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וְהִנֵּה־ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ צַ֣ר וָא֔וֹר חָשַׁ֖ךְ בַּעֲרִיפֶֽיהָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·yin·hōm ‘ā·lāw bay·yō·wm ha·hū kə·na·hă·maṯ- yām wə·nib·baṭ lā·’ā·reṣ wə·hin·nêh- ḥō·šeḵ ṣar wā·’ō·wr ḥā·šaḵ ba·‘ă·rî·p̄e·hā
verses.literal: In that day they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea If one looks over the land he will see darkness and distress even the light will be obscured by clouds
verses.literalPt: E bramarão contra eles naquele dia, como o bramido do mar; então olharão para a terra, e eis que só verão trevas e ânsia, e a luz se escurecerá nos céus.
